title: The Nvidia Blast Zone
text:
The Nvidia Blast Zone

Laila Khawaja, Arthur Kroeber

Gavekal Research | 12 Nov 2026

The Nvidia scandal now looks certain to topple CEO Jensen Huang, who had affairs with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence asset, and with one of his subordinates. The questions now are what the longer-term impacts will be both on Nvidia and the US and Chinese AI ecosystems. Understandably, much coverage has focused on the spying and sex angles, but the crucial issues lie elsewhere.The biggest risk to Nvidia is if it or Huang is found to have knowingly colluded in the diversion of export-controlled chips from a Singapore datacenter to unauthorized end-users in China. The biggest risk to China’s AI industry is that the scandal leads to a tightening of US export controls on advanced chips and chip-making equipment, possibly by the end of this year. And while the US AI industry can probably weather the tumult inside Nvidia—especially if the board swiftly ousts Huang and installs credible new leadership—the scandal raises the chance that the incoming Democratic Congress will push for much tougher regulation of the sector.
